text:
Sam: quick flag from today's usability pass on bulk API key upload — few urgent UX/a11y fixes. Short thread.

Noor: share repro?

Sam: Console > Credentials > Bulk create > Upload CSV > Submit. Modal closes immediately, toast 'Batch created' then disappears. No durable confirmation and keyboard focus moves to page chrome.

Priya: confirmed with NVDA. Screen reader reads 'dialog closed' and focus lands on search. Users can't access the generated secrets.

Sam: copy mismatch too. Some areas say 'one-time secret', others 'visible only once'. We should standardize.

DevBot: Copied lint: credentials/bulk-uploader.tsx: copy-inconsistency.

Sam: proposed fixes: keep a pinned confirmation dialog after submit that lists generated keys (masked + reveal), includes 'Download CSV' CTA and requires an explicit 'I have saved these' action to dismiss.

Noor: agree. It must trap focus and announce: 'X keys created. They will be visible only once.' role=dialog + aria-modal.

Priya: keyboard order: Download CTA should be reachable before the large scrollable list. Use sticky header.

Ops: backend note — current CSV limit is 50 rows and returns 422 with vague error. We should return row-level errors like [{index, error}]. Ops can change API to that shape.

Sam: UI should surface per-row validation in preview and allow exporting a failed-rows CSV.

QA: e2e flake: PR #6384 failing on keyboard trap. See CI: https://ci.redwood/6384

Priya: accessibility checklist: focus trap, sr-only announcement, keyboardable download, contrast on failed-row highlight, aria-describedby linking to per-row message.

Ben: RBAC UX: when permission missing show which permission is required (credentials.create:bulk) and a link to request access. Current message is unhelpful.

Sam: additional ask: allow optional metadata column in CSV (eg env/team) and show a column-mapping step in the upload wizard with preview of first 10 rows.

Noor: limit preview to 200 rows in UI and validate full file server-side. Show 'Max rows: 500' if we set that.

Ben: revoke flow idea: for bulk revoke show a progress modal with counts and allow a 30s UI 'undo' that actually re-creates keys if needed (but note in copy that audit records are immediate).

Priya: copy suggestion for confirmation header: 'These keys are visible only once. Download them now.' Keep consistent with single-key language.

Sam: action items: Noor mock pinned confirmation and sticky header; Priya add a11y annotations; Ops + Dev to add row-level error payload; QA to add e2e for focus trapping and failed-row export; Ben to update RBAC messaging. Sync tomorrow 9:30am.
